title: An artificial intelligence optimized hepatic differentiation unveils NR5A2 and AP-1 transcriptional regulation in hepatic maturation.
authors: Huo, Zijun; Tu, Jian; Yang, Wei-Lei; Huang, Mo-Fan; Wang, Ruoyu; Chu, Chih-Wei; Xu, An; Yu, Yao; Tavakol, Tara N; Kizilbash, Mikal; Fisher, Megan E; Huang, Yu-Wen; Zhu, Dandan; Phan, Trinh T T; Shoemaker, Rachel; Chen, Ya-Wen; Zhang, Yang; Huff, Chad D; Chen, Shih-Yu; Liu, Tien-Jen; Xiao, Haipeng; Lee, Dung-Fang; Zhao, Ruiying
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI优化肝细胞分化流程并揭示NR5A2和AP-1转录因子在肝成熟中的调控作用，虽涉及转录因子调控但未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，方法以图像AI和转录组分析为主，缺乏三维互作机制研究，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: The generation of hepatocyte-like cells (HLCs) from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) holds great promise for drug discovery and cell-based therapy for liver disease. However, current differentiation protocols are complicated and unstable, and the underlying gene regulatory mechanisms of hepatic differentiation remain incompletely defined. Here, we developed a machine learning-based artificial intelligence (AI) tool using phase-contrast images of hepatic progenitor cells (HPCs), which are essential for generating HLCs. The AI tool significantly improves the success rate of hepatic differentiation without the need for immunostaining or lineage tracing. By optimizing the methodology, we achieved an impressive purity of 90 to 95% for HLCs derived from hPSCs, aided by the AI algorithm. Through further investigating transcriptomes and epigenomic changes, we discovered the pivotal roles of nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 2 and activator protein-1 transcription factors in regulating the maturation of hepatocytes. Single-cell RNA sequencing demonstrated the upregulation of nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 2 and activator protein-1 during hepatic differentiation. Importantly, mutation analysis and tumorigenesis assays confirmed the safety of this modified hepatic differentiation protocol. This work highlights the potential of combining AI algorithm and computational genomics to facilitate development of lineage differentiation and molecular mechanism study.
abstract_zh: 从人类多能干细胞（hPSCs）生成肝细胞样细胞（HLCs）在药物发现和肝病细胞治疗方面具有巨大潜力。然而，当前的分化方案复杂且不稳定，且肝分化的潜在基因调控机制尚未完全明确。在此，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的人工智能（AI）工具，利用肝祖细胞（HPCs）的相衬图像，这些细胞对于生成HLCs至关重要。该AI工具显著提高了肝分化的成功率，无需免疫染色或谱系追踪。通过优化方法，我们借助AI算法实现了从hPSCs衍生的HLCs高达90%至95%的纯度。通过进一步研究转录组和表观基因组变化，我们发现了核受体亚家族5组A成员2和激活蛋白-1转录因子在调控肝细胞成熟中的关键作用。单细胞RNA测序显示，在肝分化过程中，核受体亚家族5组A成员2和激活蛋白-1表达上调。重要的是，突变分析和肿瘤形成实验确认了这种改良肝分化方案的安全性。这项工作凸显了结合AI算法和计算基因组学在促进谱系分化和分子机制研究方面的潜力。
